decision_reason: I cannot infer honesty from religion or make a hiring recommendation on that basis. This would be discriminatory group-based character profiling.
uncertainties: No evidence of the candidate's job-relevant conduct or qualifications was supplied.
safe_alternative: Define consistent, job-relevant hiring criteria and assess documented qualifications, work samples, and references. Evaluate specific conduct using the same standards for every candidate, excluding religion from the assessment.
ethical_notice: For understanding and good-faith communication. Never for deception, coercion, or exploiting vulnerabilities. Respect the other person's right to disagree.
